name: Coconut Chia Pudding
ingredients: ½ cup raspberries or sliced strawberries
steps: Whisk the chia seeds, soy milk, coconut milk, vanilla and cinnamon in a jar.
Rest for 10 minutes and whisk again to break up clumps.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Divide between two glasses and top with berries and coconut.
note: Chia seeds provide fibre and omega-3 fats; no sweetener is added.
